# Marie Glow Studio

> Marie Glow Studio is a digital studio in Wichita, KS that helps product and service small businesses with web design and development, Pinterest marketing, SEO and digital strategy.

One person, Marie Harvey, does the work start to finish, so the website, search visibility and marketing are planned together. The studio works remotely with small businesses across the United States. Websites are built on Shopify for online stores or custom-coded for service businesses, connected to booking tools, quote forms or checkout. Every price is published on its service page.

## Services

- [All services and prices](https://marieglowstudio.com/services): how the four services connect, with every price
- [Web Design & Development](https://marieglowstudio.com/web-design): websites for small product and service businesses
  - [Website Starter](https://marieglowstudio.com/website-starter): $249 one-time, a professional one-page site live in about 5 business days
  - [Complete Website & Brand Identity](https://marieglowstudio.com/complete-website-package): $1,497 one-time, branding plus a multi-page site on Shopify or custom-coded
- [Pinterest Marketing](https://marieglowstudio.com/pinterest-marketing): Pinterest as a search engine that sends steady traffic
  - [Pinterest SEO Audit](https://marieglowstudio.com/pinterest-audit): $197 one-time, full account audit plus a ranked 30-day plan
  - [Pinterest Account Setup](https://marieglowstudio.com/pinterest-account-setup): $497 one-time, the account built or rebuilt on the right keywords and boards
  - [Pinterest Management](https://marieglowstudio.com/pinterest-management): $497, $797 or $1,097 a month, no minimum commitment
- [SEO](https://marieglowstudio.com/seo): website SEO, local SEO and answer-engine optimization
  - [Website SEO Audit](https://marieglowstudio.com/website-seo-audit): $247 one-time, technical, on-page, local and AI-search review with a prioritized fix list
  - [SEO Foundations Setup](https://marieglowstudio.com/seo-foundations): $697 one-time, keyword map, titles, schema, Search Console, Bing and Google Business Profile for up to 10 pages
- [Digital Strategy](https://marieglowstudio.com/digital-strategy): how the website, search, Pinterest, email and tools pass customers along
  - [Digital Strategy Roadmap](https://marieglowstudio.com/digital-strategy-roadmap): $397 one-time, customer-journey map and a written 90-day plan, credited toward the Complete package within 60 days

## Who it is for

- [Product businesses](https://marieglowstudio.com/for-product-businesses): shops, makers, handmade brands, boutiques and digital products
- [Service businesses](https://marieglowstudio.com/for-service-businesses): salons, spas, contractors, home services, coaches, consultants and local businesses

## Blog

Blog posts live at https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/ and each post is at https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/<post-slug>. Posts are grouped into 9 topics:

- [Blog index](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/): every post, newest first
- [How Pinterest Works](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/how-pinterest-works): How Pinterest search actually works, how pins get shown, and what that means for a small business that wants steady traffic.
- [Keywords and Getting Found](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/keywords-and-getting-found): Keyword research, where keywords go, and how to be found by the people already searching for what you sell.
- [Pinterest Setup, Pins and Strategy](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/pinterest-setup-pins-and-strategy): Business account setup, profile and board SEO, pin titles and descriptions, audits, content calendars and Pinterest strategy.
- [Shopify and Web Design](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/shopify-and-web-design): Website tips for product and service businesses: redesign checklists, booking and quote pages, Shopify product pages, photography and the design choices that turn visitors into customers.
- [Branding and Launching](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/branding-and-launching): Cohesive branding, brand trust and product launch basics for physical and digital product businesses.
- [Email Marketing](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/email-marketing): Building an email list, lead magnets, welcome sequences and how email works alongside Pinterest.
- [Behind the Brand](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/behind-the-brand): The story behind Marie Glow Studio: starting a product business from home, burnout, motherhood and why Pinterest is still a favorite.
- [SEO and Search Visibility](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/seo-and-search-visibility): Website SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile and answer-engine optimization, so product and service businesses show up when people search on Google and ask AI tools.
- [Digital Strategy](https://marieglowstudio.com/blog/category/digital-strategy): How the website, search, Pinterest, email and booking tools work together, and how a small business decides what to fix first.

## Comparisons, free tools and guides

- [Comparisons](https://marieglowstudio.com/compare/): Honest side by side comparisons to help you choose between doing it yourself, using a tool, or hiring help.
  - [Should I Hire a Pinterest Manager or Do It Myself?](https://marieglowstudio.com/compare/pinterest-manager-vs-diy): An honest side by side of doing Pinterest yourself versus hiring a manager, with the cases where DIY is the better choice.
  - [Pinterest Scheduler vs Pinterest Manager: Which Do You Need?](https://marieglowstudio.com/compare/pinterest-management-service-vs-scheduling-tool): A scheduling tool publishes the pins you give it, while a manager handles strategy, keywords, design, scheduling and reporting.
  - [One Page Website vs Shopify Store: Which Fits Your Business?](https://marieglowstudio.com/compare/one-page-website-vs-shopify-store): A plain comparison of a $249 one-page website and a full Shopify store, including when the simple option is enough.
  - [Pinterest Audit vs Setup vs Management: Which Comes First?](https://marieglowstudio.com/compare/pinterest-audit-vs-setup-vs-management): A three way guide to the Pinterest audit ($197), account setup ($497) and monthly management (from $497 a month), and who each one is for.
- [Free Tools](https://marieglowstudio.com/tools/): Free Pinterest tools that run in your browser. No login, and nothing you type is stored.
  - [Free Pinterest Pin Title and Description Checker](https://marieglowstudio.com/tools/pinterest-pin-title-description-checker): Check a pin title and description against Pinterest’s real limits and simple keyword placement guidelines.
  - [Pinterest Pins Per Month Calculator](https://marieglowstudio.com/tools/pinterest-pins-per-month-calculator): Turn your product or page count into a monthly pin plan, the hours it takes, and which management tier covers it.
  - [Pinterest Profile and Board SEO Scorecard](https://marieglowstudio.com/tools/pinterest-profile-seo-scorecard): Twelve yes or no checks across your profile, boards, pins and website, with a score and a suggested next step.
- [Guides](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/): Pinterest and website guides written for specific kinds of small business.
  - [Pinterest Marketing for Etsy Sellers: Get Found in Search](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/pinterest-marketing-for-etsy-sellers): Etsy sellers who only pin their own listing photos get little traction because Pinterest is a search engine, so pins need to match what people type.
  - [Pinterest Marketing for Handmade Business Owners](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/pinterest-marketing-for-handmade-businesses): Handmade brands have story and process content that Pinterest rewards; here is how to balance product pins with inspiration and organize boards for search.
  - [Pinterest Marketing for Coaches and Course Creators](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/pinterest-marketing-for-coaches-and-course-creators): Coaches and course creators do best on Pinterest by pinning the problems people search for, then moving visitors to an email opt-in.
  - [Pinterest Marketing for Busy Business Owners, Made Simple](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/pinterest-marketing-for-busy-business-owners): You do not have to learn all of Pinterest: a minimum routine, what to hand off and how to choose between an audit, setup and monthly management.
  - [Pinterest Marketing for Print on Demand and Custom Shops](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/pinterest-marketing-for-custom-product-and-print-shops): Shops with many similar custom or print products need more than one pin each, built around different occasions, audiences and themes.
  - [Shopify Website for a Handmade Brand: What the Store Needs](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/shopify-website-for-handmade-and-creative-brands): How to build a Shopify store that carries a handmade brand's personality, tells the maker story and makes products easy to find and buy.
  - [One Page Website for Coaches and Course Creators](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/one-page-website-for-coaches-and-course-creators): What a one page site must contain for a coach or course creator, what it cannot do, and how to tell when it is time for something bigger.
  - [Shopify Website for Digital Product Sellers: A Practical Guide](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/shopify-website-for-digital-product-sellers): How to present digital products on Shopify so buyers know what they get, how they get it and what they may do with it.
  - [Shopify Brand Identity for New Store Owners: Logo to Style Guide](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/shopify-brand-identity-for-new-store-owners): Why a new Shopify store should settle its logo, colors, fonts and style guide before the build, and what a style guide is actually used for.
  - [Shopify Store Redesign: When to Rebuild, Fix and What to Keep](https://marieglowstudio.com/guides/shopify-store-redesign-for-existing-stores): How to decide between fixing and redesigning an existing Shopify store, what to keep, and how to scope the work and protect your search visibility.
